summary: New agent-payment / MIS-format feature set verified. Backend: fixed 4 pre-existing test files that broke because payment_mode became a required upload field and the sample fixture's OCR'd policy number/MIS header shape changed (now 35/35 pytest passing, up from 21/21 broken-by-4). Added 7 new backend test files covering exact MIS header match to /tmp/mis_order.xlsx, long-policy-number text preservation (xlsx + csv), upload payment-mode validation, partial-payment outstanding math, payment recording (+403/400 paths), agent-outstanding scoping, and OCR broker-name capture. Browser: 4 new named checks passed (1 via the public preview URL) covering dropzone payment-mode gating, the full partial-payment-to-outstanding-to-recording UI flow, outstanding-page + dashboard KPI + policies-page payment columns scoping, and the editable Broker/Agent/POS name field after OCR. All 7 acceptance criteria from the briefing exercised across both lanes. Deleted all 62 test-fixture policies created during this session (and pre-existing generic sample.png/tscheck-* residue from earlier iterations) via admin DELETE so the seeded 18-policy MIS stays clean; left 2 ambiguous realistically-named pdf fixtures (Policy_POCMVPC0100764965.pdf, 500503312610001941.pdf, dated today but not matching any fixture-file naming this agent uses) untouched since they may be main-agent demo data rather than test residue.
action_items: note: 2 policies (Policy_POCMVPC0100764965.pdf, 500503312610001941.pdf, agent codes AGT1005/AGT1001, created 2026-10-06) look like manual/demo uploads rather than seeded or test-fixture rows; left in place since they don't match this session's fixtures — main agent may want to confirm/delete if they are stray test data.
